headline: Jahmyr Gibbs scores three touchdowns and Kyra stays perfect at 3-0
dek: Marlee's right there with her, also 3-0. Cambri lost the closest game of the week with a banged-up Justin Jefferson, Samantha got the worst kind of news on De'Von Achane, and Maddie is still looking for win number one.

matchups.6-7: Kyra put up 170.48, the highest score in the league so far this season, riding a monster day from Jahmyr Gibbs: 99 rushing yards, 65 receiving yards, three total touchdowns, 41.4 points. Samantha's 95.46 was the least of her problems — De'Von Achane managed 3 carries for 17 yards before leaving the game, and it turned out to be a torn ACL. He's done for the season. Kyra is 3-0.
matchups.5-8: The closest game of the week: Maya beat Cambri by 3.46. Bijan Robinson ran for 194 yards and two touchdowns (35.3 points) to cover for a quiet Omarion Hampton (56 yards, 5.6 points). Cambri's Justin Jefferson played through an ankle injury and managed just 5.2 points on two catches — reports afterward said it isn't serious and he should be back in Week 4, which does Cambri no good this week.
matchups.1-4: Marlee stayed perfect at 3-0, winning by 23.22. George Kittle scored two touchdowns and put up 26.2 points at tight end while Mark Andrews sat on her bench with 5.4. Tara lost despite being projected for 138.53: Christian Watson scored 22.6 from her bench while Quinshon Judkins started in the flex and got 9.9.
matchups.2-3: Amie improved to 2-1, winning by 50.76 behind a Patrick Mahomes waiver pickup that threw for 246 yards and two touchdowns (15.94 points) in his first week on her roster. Maddie fell to 0-3. Jonathan Taylor was projected for 20.62 and managed 9.2 — a season-low day for him, no excuse required.

game_balls.title: Gibbs has himself a game
game_balls.text: Two rushing touchdowns, a receiving touchdown, 164 total yards, 41.4 fantasy points — the best individual performance in the league this season. Kyra didn't need to make a single tough call this week; she just watched.

game_balls.title: Kittle over Andrews, easy
game_balls.text: Started George Kittle (26.2 points, two touchdowns) over Mark Andrews (5.4) at tight end. That's a 20.8-point swing in a game Marlee won by 23.22 — comfortable, but it's exactly the kind of call that keeps a 3-0 team 3-0.

game_balls.title: Mahomes off the waiver wire, working immediately
game_balls.text: Claimed Patrick Mahomes off waivers this week and started him right away. He threw for 246 yards and two touchdowns for 15.94 points, and Amie moved to 2-1.

game_balls.title: A bright spot in a loss
game_balls.text: Picked up Jordan Love as a free agent and got 18.48 points out of him (312 yards, two touchdowns) in his very first game on her roster. The rest of the lineup didn't cooperate, but the pickup itself was a good one.

flags.title: Started the wrong tight end
flags.text: Played Dalton Schultz (6 points) over Brock Bowers, who scored 27.6 on her bench. The worst bench call in the league this week — and Maya still won, so no consequences, just embarrassment.

flags.title: Watson sat, and it cost her
flags.text: Benched Christian Watson, who scored 22.6, in favor of Quinshon Judkins in the flex, who scored 9.9. Tara lost by 23.22 — that gap alone would have flipped this game.

flags.title: Even 3-0 teams make mistakes
flags.text: Started Ladd McConkey (10.6) over Michael Wilson, who put up 25.9 on the bench. Marlee won anyway, comfortably, so this one's purely for the record.

flags.title: The Waddle bet stopped paying off
flags.text: Two weeks ago, starting Jaylen Waddle over DK Metcalf was a Week 2 game ball. This week it went the other way: Waddle scored 6.4 while Metcalf sat on the bench with 12.1. Maddie fell to 0-3.

tough_breaks.title: Achane's season is over
tough_breaks.text: De'Von Achane went down early against the Chiefs, and it turned out to be a torn ACL — done for the year. He'd managed just 3 carries for 17 yards before leaving, which is the least important part of this news.

tough_breaks.title: Playing hurt, in the league's closest game
tough_breaks.text: Justin Jefferson was dealing with an ankle injury and finished with just two catches for 32 yards. Reports afterward said it isn't serious and he's expected to play in Week 4 — cold comfort for Cambri, who lost this one by 3.46.

glossary.definition: The player who takes handoffs and runs the ball, and often catches passes too. Jahmyr Gibbs, Bijan Robinson, and De'Von Achane are all running backs — this league lives and dies by them.
The pool of players nobody has rostered. When someone gets dropped or breaks out, managers submit claims and whoever wins gets them off waivers — usually a few days after games, not instantly.
A player who scores way under what was expected of him. Jonathan Taylor's 9.2 points on a 20.62 projection is a textbook bust — sometimes there's no reason, a good player just has a bad day.
Your one defensive roster spot, scored as a team: points for sacks and turnovers, points off for how much the other team scores and gains. Yes, it can go negative — Tara found that out this week.
